tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa las: phrin las rgyun khyer las byang bsdus pa nor bu pad+ma'i phreng ba bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ thugs dam gsang ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa las: rgyun khyer las byang bsdus pa nor bu pad+ma'i phreng ba bstan: 'di la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo: sā mā yā: rgyaḥchahratha: sngon 'gro dang po bgegs gtor gtang: gnyis pa mtshams gcad srung 'khor bsgom: gsum pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang: bzhi pa tshogs gsag yan lag 'bul: lnga pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab: drug pa bshags pa bya ba 'o: dang po sngon 'gro rtsa ba'i tho yig rdzogs so: / /: de la dang po bgegs bskrad pa: bgegs gtor phyir bsgyur 'di skad gyer: hūm̐: bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: dngos grub sgrub la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: bdud dang log 'dren lan chags 'byung po'i tshogs: che mchog pad+ma dbang chen rta mgrin gyis: bskrad gzir mnan nas ming yang med par byed: de bas gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐: gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐: gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho: bha ga bān bid+yā rā dzā ya gnod byed 'byung po sarba u tsa ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas mtshams gcad srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang chen rab 'jigs me dpung 'bar: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje 'phros: dkar ser dmar ljang rab tu 'khrugs pa las: 'khor lo rdo rje pad+ma ral gri dang: rin chen 'bar ba kha ṭ+wāṃ be con bcas: gtun shing mda' dang chu gri tho ba'i tshogs: sa chu me rlung spu gri reg chod dang: nam mkha' sngo sangs gdod nas dag pa'i gur: khro tshogs dpag med srung ba'i gur khang 'khrigs: rlung yang 'gyu ba'i skabs ni ma mchis na: bgegs dang log 'dren bdud kyis glags med do: oṃ badz+ra kro dha pad+mān+ta kṛta ha ya grī ba hūm̐ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa:

de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: 1$0000250mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gsal: 1$0000300kyai: dus gsum sangs rgyas bla ma o rgyan rje: dngos grub gter 'byung yi dam zhi khro dang: bar chad bgegs 'dul mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas: 'gro ba sems can yongs kyi gnyen gcig pu: mgon po mchog gyur rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gyur med rje btsun pad+ma saṃ bha ba: yi dam rta mgrin mkha' 'gror bcas pa la: bdag gi sgo gsum gus pas bran du 'bul: gnas skabs mthar thug bye brag thams cad kyi: bde sdug re ltos 'dun gtad khyed shes pas: bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsol ba dang: dbang bskur byin rlabs deng 'dir bstsal du gsol: de nas mchog sems bskyed pa ni: ho: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams: ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la: yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: de nas brda sgo dbye zhing tshogs gnyis gsag pa ni: mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i steng du rta mgrin dbang gi lha tshogs: sku 'od dang gzi brjid du 'bar ba: gsung rngam la dbang drag dang ldan pa: thugs zhi zhing ngo mtshar ba dang bcas te snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa chu nang gi zla ba lta bu: gsal la 'dzin pa med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur bzhugs pa'i thugs kar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad dang ldan pa la: nyi ma la gnas pa'i dbus su hrīḥyig gi mtha' mar kha ṭ+wāṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ āṃḥtāṃ oṃ gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros te bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung 'khrig pa lta bur spyan drangs la: pra be sha ya ho: sa ma ya dzaḥdza: brda phyag 'tshal ba ni rang gi lus rdul snyed du sprul te: gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: tshogs gnyis gsag pa ni: rang gi thugs ka nas ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas: shab+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐:

ces pa'i rjes su yan lag bdun pa 'di yis gsal gdab bo: hrī: bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems: rgyal sras rang rgyal mkha' 'gro dang: phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor rnams: 'dir gshegs bzhugs la byin gyis rlobs: rdul snyed sprul pa'i lus kyis su: phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i bye brag rnams: nam mkha'i mtha' klas rab bkang ste: so sor dpag med dmigs te 'bul: sgo gsum sdig pa'i las la sogs: rig dang ma rig nyams chag bshags: mya ngan 'da' bzhed dam pa rnams: sems can ma lus kun don du: chos 'khor bskor zhing bzhugs gsol 'debs: sems can don mdzad mgon po rnams: rjes su yi rang mngon par bstod: dus gsum tshogs gnyis gang bsags pa: ma gyur sems can don du bsngo: ye shes kyi tshogs ni: 'dzin bya 'dzin byed phyi nang gang yang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag: oṃ shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: de nas phyi nang gsang mchod thams cad byin gyis brlab pa ni: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsreg: swa bhā ba sa sbyang: stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas rnams gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa: lha mi las 'das pa'i mchod sprin: kun tu bzang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba: nam mkha' dang mnyam zhing dus ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du zad mi shes pa dbang chen gsang ba'i mchod sprin du gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra nai bid+yā pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she pū dza dharma pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā gu h+ya shu krang pū dza āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā:

oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ye hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: sarba pū dza ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: zhes mchod sprin 'bul zhing bshags pa ni: hrī: dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la: dag pa rnam dag yid kyis mchod sprin 'di: sku gsung thugs kyi klong du 'bul gyis bzhes: ma rig bdag gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig 'gal 'khrul rnams: ye shes klong yangs ngang du bshags par bgyi: yi ge brgya pa brjod do: sa ma ya: gu h+ya: ྈྈྈ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni: dang po ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum: gnyis pa 'byung rim ri rab bskyed: gsum pa gzhal yas gdan bcas gsal: bzhi pa ye shes lha tshogs spyon: lnga pa bzhugs shing drug pa phyag: bdun pa phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul: brgyad pa bstod pa gsal gdab cing: dgu pa dzap bsnyen rim pa ste: dngos gzhi rtsa thor bsdebs pa 'o: sa ma ya: rda thim: ྈྈྈྈ de nas dang po ting nge 'dzin gsum bsgom pa ni: oṃ shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: gis/ snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa'i ngo bo las: de bzhin nyid do: lam las ma grol ba'i sems can la khyab pa'i snying rje chen po bsgom: a sarba dharma swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: kun tu snang ngo: snying rje chen po de'i ngang du 'gro kun bde ba la bkod cing sdug bsngal las bsgral ba'i phyir du: rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin ni: rgyu yi yi ge hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang ldan pa las 'od zer yi ge bdun du shar te: 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni: e yaṃ raṃ ra laṃ kiṃ bh+rūm̐ 'phros pas: e las nam mkha' mthing nag gru gsum gdengs ka gyen du phyogs pa: yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang nag gzhu dbyibs rgya gram du 'dug pa: raṃ las me ri dmar nag gru gsum du 'bar ba: ra las khrag gi rgya mtsho dmar po zlum por 'khyil zhing mi ro dang rta ro lang ling lbu ba 'khrugs pa:

laṃ las dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi gru bzhir gdal ba la dur khrod kyi bkod pa rdza ltar nyil ba: kiṃ las keng rus kyi ri rab gru bzhi bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa la bya sha zan: gcan gzan khrag 'thung mang po'i tshang 'cha' ba: dkyil 'khor bskyed pa: de'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las dbang chen dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bsam ste: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe hūm̐: zhes brjod pas bh+rūm̐ smug nag las dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa: dbus gru gsum dmar nag la: zla gam kha sprod du 'dug pa la pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi yis mtshan pa: de'i phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs bcu: bar khyams sgo dang sgo khyud ldan pa'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga: thod pa skam rlon ra ris brtsigs shing rin po che sna lnga las grub pa: nyi ma dang zla ba'i mthongs khung dang: zhing chung gi dral drab dang: zhing chen gyi ka gdung dang: zhing rlon pa'i rgyal mtshan dang: zhing lpags kyi bla re dang: rkang chen gyi rta babs dang: thod rlon gyi kha bad dang: zhag chen gyi chu ris dang: khrag chen gyi rgya mtsho dang: tsit+ta'i gur chen po dang: tshil chen gyi dud pa dang: go ro tsa na'i zha la chen po dang: ba su ta'i dra ba ris dang: mkhal ma'i pho to dang: mig gi phreng ba dang: yan lag gi 'phan gyis brgyan cing zhing gi lhu dum gyi ga ta ru bcas pa'o: de'i phyi rol thams cad rdo rje rgya gram dang: rdo rje rtse gcig dang: rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang: rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang: rdo rje rtse dgu pa la sogs me dang bcas pa'i dra gur bar mtshams med par gtams shing 'khrigs pa'o: de dag gi nang ngos su dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi 'khor yug dang pad+ma'i phreng bas 'khor mar bskor ba'o: de nas gdan bskyed pa ni: de ltar gyi gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su: rin po che sna lnga'i khri dang: in+d+ra gar bha'i mgo bo 'khrigs pa'i dbus su rak+ta'i mtsho las pad+ma'i sdong po ge sar dang bcas pa'i steng du nyi ma zla ba bam ro rak+ta'i klong du klu brgyad dang pad+ma'i ge sar la lha chen po brgyad:

gza' chen po brgyad: nor srung chen po brgyad kyi khri 'degs dang bcas pa gsal: dbus su lha bskyed pa ni: bdag nyid ye nas ma bcos rdzogs pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rta mgrin sku mdog dmar la rngam pa: zhal lnga phyag bcu drug: zhabs brgyad dang ldan pa: sku che la yan lag rags pa: dbu la rta dbu lnga dang ldan pa: zhal lnga ni: rtsa zhal dmar po rngam zhing bzhad pa: shar gyi zhal mdog dkar la zhi ba: lho zhal ser po ser la 'tsher ba: nub zhal mthing nag brjid la 'bar ba: byang zhal ljang nag drag la khros pa'o: zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum: mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa: snyan bcu gsang la ma 'gags pa: shangs lnga nas ye shes kyi rlung lnga lnga pho rlung mo rlung zung 'jug tu rgyu ba: sma ra dang smin ma me ltar 'bar ba: dbu skra sprin ltar gtibs pa la thod skam sbrul dkar gyis dpral bar bcings pa: thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal dang: phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa brgyad kyis rim pa bzhin du rdo rje rtse dgu pa: rtse lnga: lcags kyu: ral gri: nam mkha' lding: gsal shing: me dpung: zhing snying dang bcas pa 'dzin pa'o: g.yon pa brgyad du: thod pa khrag gis bkang ba: chu skyes: tshe'i ga'u: gshol mda': sbrul zhags: dbang gi phyag rgya: gser gyi 'khor lo: rdo rje rgya gram bsnams pa'o: zhabs brgyad kyis 'dor thabs su lha chen po tshogs kyi bdag po brgyad brdzis pa'o: g.yas su rdo rje 'bar ba'i gshog pa la: ke'u rī ma sogs ma mo brgyad 'gyed pa'o: g.yon du ral gri'i gshog pa la siṃ ha ma sogs phra men ma brgyad 'gyed pa: nor bu 'bar ba'i thil phran la gnod sbyin nor bdag brgyad 'gyed pa'o: gzhan yang dur khrod kyi chas brgyad: dpal gyi chas dgu dang ldan pa'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas gri gug: g.yon thod khrag bsnams nas yab la 'khril ba: sku la dur khrod du mas brgyan cing spyi bor phag zhal ngur ba'o:

de ltar yab yum gnyis med 'khril sbyor bde stong dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la gu ru pad+ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams nas yum la 'khyud pa: yum mtsho rgyal dkar mo nor bu dang thod pa bsnams nas yab la 'khyud par gsal ba'o: rang gi thugs ka me dpung khrag mtsho pad+ma thabs shes dbyer med nyi zla bam ro'i gdan dang klu brgyad brtsegs pa'i khri la: rang sems kyi ngo bo hrīḥyig de yongs su gyur pa las: bdag nyid khro bo chen po rta mgrin dbang gi sku mdog dmar nag 'bar ba la: rnam par thar pa'i zhal gsum dang: pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi phyag drug dang: tshad med pa bzhi yi mche ba bzhi bzhi dang: rdzu 'phrul gyi zhabs bzhi dang: sa dgu non pa'i spyan dgu dang: gzhan yang glang po che dang: stag sham dang: zhing lpags dang: thal chen dang: khrag zhag dang: thod pa'i phreng bas sgeg pa dang: zhe sdang gi sbrul dang: pad+ma'i chun po dang: rdo rje'i thod phreng dang: keng rus kyi ka ma ha dang: 'khor lo'i ka ta ha dang: rin po che'i na ro ha dang: khyad par rdo rje dang: pad+ma dang: ral gri'i gshog pa dang: nga rgyal drag po ha ha'i sgra dang: zhe sdang drag po ru lu'i gdangs dang: gsod byed rngams pa hu lu'i nga ro dang: tsham rngam drag po hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sgras klu bdud ma rungs pa thams cad dbang du sdud pa'o: thugs ye shes kyi 'khor lo la rang snying nyi ma dang bcas pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis 'dod khams yongs kyi gzi byin skyed cing sku yi 'khor lo gsal ba'i phyag drug tu: rdo rje rtse dgu dang: ral gri dang: ro dang: thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba dang: rgyu ma'i zhags pa dang: nam mkha' lding gi gzugs bsnams pa'o: de ltar du gyur pa'i pang du rang gi rig pa'i snang ba las: yum gzi ldan pad+ma can sku mdog dmar gsal dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa:

phyag tu mdung rtse gsum dang: ka pā la stob cing 'khril bar gyur: g.yon du thugs ye nas dag cing gsal ba las: sgrol ba'i yum sgeg mo ral gcig ma sku mdog smug nag phyag tu gri dang snying bzung ba'o: yab yum gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi sems las: sprul pa'i phra men ma byi la dang pu shud kyi mgo can: sku mdog dmar nag la zhing gi lpags rlon khur zhing lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa gnyis yab yum gyi g.yas g.yon 'gyed pa'o: yab yum gyi mdun du sku'i sprul pa las: khro bo chen po gtum drag ces bya ba: sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: g.yas kyi dang pos pad+ma dang: g.yon pas ral gri bsnams shing: 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'o: sku la rin po ches brgyan te: pang du de bzhin rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dkar mo phyag na 'khor lo gri dang ka pā la stob pa'o: phyogs bzhi'i shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog sngon mo phyag na dril bu dang ka pā la bsnams pa'o: lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ser mo gri dang ka pā la bsnams pa'o: nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo phyag tu pad+ma dang ka pā la bsnams pa'o: byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ljang gu rgya gram dang ka pā la bsnams pa'o: gsung gi sprul pa las khro bo klu las rgyal byed ces bya ba sku mdog dmar nag zhal g.yas dkar zhing g.yon in+d+ra nī la ltar ljang zhing dbus dmar 'tsher du 'bar ba'i: sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang rus pas brgyan pa: phyag tu pad+ma'i sdong bu dang: ral gri dang: me yi maṇ+ḍal dang: nam mkha' lding dang: phyag lhag ma gnyis kyis sbrul rigs lnga zhal du za ba'o: de'i phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs bcu la rim pa bzhin du thugs kyi sprul pa las: khro bo chen po hūm̐ kā ra dang: rnam par rgyal ba dang: dbyug sngon can dang: gshin rje'i gshed dang:

mgon po mi g.yo ba dang: pad+ma'i rgyal po dang: gzhan las rgyal ba dang: bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang: khams gsum rgyal byed dang: stobs po che la sogs pa thams cad rang rang gi yum dang phyag mtshan cha lugs phra men bcas rdzogs par bzhugs pa'o: de'i phyi rim gyi 'khor yug tu ma mo brgyad: phra men ma brgyad: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad: bse yi lha mo bzhi dang: khyams la phyogs skyong bcu: lha brgyad: klu brgyad: gza' brgyad: gnod sbyin nor bdag brgyad: dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhi sogs dbang chen gsang ba'i lha tshogs ma mo mkha' 'gro bcas gsal bar bskyed pa'i lha rnams dang: gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang chen gsang ba'i lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs dam tshig gi lha rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur

par bsam la: badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: o rgyan bde chen mkha' spyod pho brang nas: bla ma bde gshegs kun bzang he ru ka: rigs 'dus bdag nyid mgon po 'od dpag med: mtshan dpe'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs: sku gsum lhun grub gu ru pad+ma 'byung: byin rlabs rtsa brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol: hrī: bde chen chos nyid 'du 'bral med pa'i klong: thugs rje'i thabs kyis khro bo'i skur bstan pa: rang bzhin gnas nas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na: dbang mchog rigs kyi khro rgyal gshegs su gsol: rak+ta mtsho ltar 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog nas: gzi ldan pad+ma spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rus chen rdza ltar lhags pa'i gnas rab nas: sgeg mo ral gcig spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: tsit+ta gdan du bkod pa'i gnas mchog nas: sprul pa'i phra men spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: tshil chen sprin du gtibs pa'i gnas mchog nas: sku sprul khro rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i pho brang nas: gsung sprul dbang chen klu gshed gshegs su gsol: phyogs skyong dregs pa brdzis pa'i gdan steng nas: thugs sprul khro rgyal bcu rnams gshegs su gsol: rang bzhin dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: dbang gi ma mo brgyad rnams gshegs su gsol: siṃ ha rngams chen rol pa'i yul brgyad nas: yul gyi phra men brgyad rnams gshegs su gsol: sgal tshigs ri ltar spungs pa'i gnas mchog nas: dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad rnams gshegs su gsol: mtsho bzhi pho brang gtams pa'i maṇ+ḍal nas: dbang gi bse mo ma bzhi gshegs su gsol: steng 'og phyogs bcu zhing gi bkod pa nas: phyogs skyong dregs pa'i sde tshogs gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi rab 'jigs dregs pa'i pho brang nas: lha klu gza' dang gnod sbyin gshegs su gsol: pho brang phyogs bzhi dregs pa'i dmag dpon che:

'jigs byed sde dpon bzhi bcas gshegs su gsol: dur khrod gsar rnying gtams pa'i gnas chen nas: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol: rnal 'byor longs spyod bkod pa'i gnas 'di ru: dbang mchog rta mgrin dkyil 'khor ma lus pa: 'gro ba'i don phyir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: e h+ye hi bha ga bān pad+ma man+dhā ra sarba sa kro dha dṛ sh+ya ho sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med bsam: hrī: dbang chen yangs pa'i gzhal yas su: pad+ma nyi zla thabs shes gdan: rtog med ro dang dregs pa'i khri: bde zhing yangs pa 'bul lags pas: 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs par mdzod: paṃ pad+ma: a tsan+d+ra: ma sūr+ya: baṃ tīk+ṣ+ṇa sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hrī: dus gsum bde gshegs rtsa brgyud gu ru rje: man ngag lung dang dbang bskur brgyud pa la: rtse gcig yid kyis dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: dbang mchog rngam brjid rta mgrin rta skad bzhad: 'gro don mdzad phyir drag po'i skur bstan pa: bdag dang mi 'bral dam tshig gcig pa'i lha: klu bdud 'byung po dbang du sdud pa'i phyir: sgo gsum dang bas gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: dbang mchog sku la 'khril ba'i mkha' 'gro ma: gzi ldan ral gcig ma mo 'bum gyi rje: dus gsum bde gshegs khro bo'i pho brang mchog: khams gsum srid pa'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo: yab yum rol pa chen po'i bde klong na: phra men rgya mtsho khro bo 'bum gyi tshogs: ma mo mkha' 'gro la sogs bka' 'khor la: dad pa'i yid kyis gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: pad+ma man+dhā ra: hrīḥpad+ma sa man+ta na mo na mā mi: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: de nas phyi nang gsang mchod rnams 'bul ba ni: dang po ar+ghaṃ 'bul te: mchod phreng 'di rnams o rgyan yul gyi nub byang gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi lugs yang dag pa yin no:

e ma bde gshegs bcom ldan 'das: sku gsung thugs kyi byang chub sems: chu yi tshul du sprul pa 'di: 'gro ba rnams kyi don mdzad phyir: lha tshogs la ni mchod par bya: 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐: de nas rang gi thugs ka nas 'dod yon sna tshogs su sprul nas phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: kun bzang thugs las sprul pa'i mchod sprin che: 'dod dgu'i re skong dpag bsam shing: 'dod pa'i gos dang zas su ldan: rin chen khang bzang gter chen mdzod: bla re rgyal mtshan yol ba mdzes: rgyan dang dpag yas rol mo bro: glu dbyangs tshigs su bcad pa'i sgra: sil snyan gling bu 'khar rnga dang: gzugs mdzes bro mchog bdud rtsi'i khron: dbang chen gsang ba'i tshogs la 'bul: hūm̐: me long 'dzin pa gzugs lha mo: sgra ni lag gnyis pi waṃ 'dzin: dri ni snod mchog spos phor 'dzin: ro ni rdo rje pad+ma'i snod: gzugs mdzes rgyan ldan reg bya ma: chos kyi lha mo glegs bam thogs: 'dod yon drug po so sor sprul: bde gshegs thugs las 'od zer bkye: dbang chen bde gshegs bcom ldan 'das: sku gsung thugs kyi klong du thim: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+yā shab+da āḥhūm̐: de nas nang mchod dug lnga'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: zla gam dmar nag dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes me ri smug nag 'khyil pa'i klong: dur khrod tshogs ris bltams pa'i gzhal yas nas: dbang mchog khro rgyal bdud 'joms rta mgrin la: sha khrag king rus dug lnga 'bul lags kyis: thugs rje chen po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: sku la rol pa'i gzi ldan pad+ma dang: dgra bgegs 'dul mdzad sgeg mo ral gcig la: sha khrag king rus dug lnga 'bul lags kyis: thugs rje rol pa bde chen dngos grub stsol:

yab yum bde chen gnyis med mkha' klong nas: sprul pa'i khro bo phra men tshogs bcas la: sha khrag king rus dug lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: mthu stobs gzi byin sngags kyi dngos grub stsol: bstan pa srung ba'i ma mo mkha' 'gro dang: dam tshig srung ba'i bka' 'khor tshogs bcas la: sha khrag king rus dug lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: bstan pa srung ba'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro tī shwa rī s+t+waṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: oṃ bud+dha shrī he ru ka bud+dha kro tī shwa rī s+t+waṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na kro tī shwa rī s+t+waṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka pad+ma kro tī shwa rī s+t+waṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro tī shwa rī s+t+waṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa: bh+yo kha kha khā hi: kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā māṃ sa la kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā ki ni ri ti la kha raṃ khā hi: gal che ba la sngags lnga dang sprad nas lan gsum gyis phul bas sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad sor chud cing phyi nang gi bar chad zhi bar 'gyur ro: de nas gsang mchod sman rag gtor gsum 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rang byung ye shes dug lnga sman du bsgyur: skye shi med pa'i bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: dag pa chen po rmad byung dam rdzas 'di: rgyal ba rgya mtsho bsnyel ba mi mnga' yang: rnal 'byor log rtog gtan nas bcom pa dang: ma sring rgya mtsho thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir: sman mchog bdud rtsi lnga yi dam rdzas 'di: dbang chen rta mgrin lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: mchod cing 'bul lo mnyes te dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛta la kha raṃ khā hi:

hūm̐: stong gsum 'khor 'das mnyam pa'i bhan+dha ru: rgyu rkyen yon tan bla med bcud gtor che: sha lnga dkar thig dmar gyi gur phub nas: sman gyi nus pa yon tan kun ldan cing: 'byor ldan bcud 'di dbang chen lha tshogs la: khams gsum dbang du sdud phyir 'bul gyis bzhes: i daṃ ba liṃ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: dung chen snod du dmar chen mdangs kyis bkang: rten 'brel bcu gnyis mū la srid pa'i rdzas: māṃ sa pad+ma ru dra'i snying khrag bcas: dbang du sdud dang dam nyams bsgral ba dang: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs phyir bzhes su gsol: ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: ces pas mchod: de nas bstod pa ni: dang po bdag bskyed dbu lnga la rgyud dgongs sku gsung thugs kyi bstod pa la: hūm̐: 'gro ba'i mgon po rdo rje lta bur chos nyid khong chud nam mkha' dang 'dra dbyer mi phyed: gsung gi bdag nyid pad+ma'i rigs mchog sin+dhu ra yi mdog can bde bar gshegs: dbang chen khro rngam dug lnga rtsad gcod 'khor lo dang mtshungs bde ba chen po'i sku: 'gro ba'i don brtson byang chub sems ldan yid bzhin nor 'dra'i thugs: bdud dpung 'joms mdzad sgyu ma'i gar mkhan rta mchog rgyal po ste: dbang bskur mchog stsol gsang ba chen po rgyan gyi rgya mtshor phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod: de nas rtsa lha mdun dkyil la rim par tshigs bcad thung dus bstod pa ni: hūm̐: dbang mchog rngams brjid khro rgyal rta mgrin sku: dregs pa 'dul phyir khro bor sku sprul zhing: sku lnga ye shes lnga bdag rta dbu lnga: zhal gsum srid gsum rab tu za bar byed: spyan dgu sa gnon spyan rtsa dmar por zlog: snyan nas 'brug stong sgrog cing ser chen 'dril: shangs nas rlung 'tshubs khro chung sa ma ya: ag tshom dmar ser dbang drag 'dus pa'i tshul: mche gtsigs zla tshes bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon: ljags 'dril bdud rigs rab tu sngangs par byed:

gti mug bdud dpung 'joms byed glang po che: za byed zhe sdang 'dul phyir stag lpags sham: nga rgyal dregs 'joms g.yang gzhi gos su gyon: phrag dog sbrul nag chun po rgyan du bzhes: thod rlon lnga bcus 'dod chags zhen pa zlog: brang 'gro'i rgyan byas rigs bzhi byol song 'dul: zhabs bzhi tshad med bzhi ldan dregs pa gnon: phyag drug pha rol phyin drug phyag mtshan drug: g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje rtse dgu yis: nyon mongs ma lus gtan nas 'joms par byed: bar mas gcod pa'i ral gri 'bar ba yis: nyon mongs 'khor ba rtsad nas gcod par byed: tha ma ti ra chen po'i dbyug pa yis: 'khor ba ma lus zhen pa zlog par byed: g.yon pas thod khrag yum la 'khyud pa ni: thabs shes gnyis ldan 'gro la chags pa'i rtags: bar mas sdigs mdzub rgyu zhags bsnams pa ni: rigs drug sems can thugs rje'i zhags pas bzung: tha mas mkha' lding rgyal po phyar ba ni: rigs bzhi klu rnams dbang du sdud par byed: gshog pa tshar gsum nam mkhar lding pa ni: phra men mang po thabs kyis 'dul bar byed: ral pa dmar nag srid rtser g.yeng ba ni: srid gsum ma lus dbang du sdud par byed: zhal nas hūm̐ phaṭa hu lu drag po'i sgras: snang srid thams cad khrag tu skyugs par mdzad: ba spu'i gseb nas khro chung gtams pa ni: ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud par byed: dbang chen ye shes lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: yon tan dpag med rgyas pa'i khro rgyal gyis: nga rgyal drag po'i klu rnams gsod pa dang: yid kyi re 'dod skong ba'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐: sku yi sprul pa khro rgyal gtum drag ni: sku mdog dmar ser nub kha'i nyi zer bzhin: sna tshogs rta dbu lnga yis dbu brgyan pa: zhal gcig phyag bzhi rngam pa'i tshul 'chang zhing: dri ma'i skyon spang rin chen du ma gsol: g.yas kyi dang pos rang rtags pad+ma bsnams: g.yon pas de bzhin ral gri gdug pa'i mtshon:

'og gnyis thabs shes 'brel ba'i mda' gzhu 'gengs: rigs kyi mkha' 'gro khrag 'thung lnga dang rol: gar dbang sku yi sras la phyag 'tshal bstod: ye shes thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzod cig: hūm̐: gsung gi sprul pa khro chen klu las rgyal: sku mdog dmar nag dus mtha'i me ltar brjid: dug gsum sgrol byed zhal gsum khro bo'i zhal: phyag drug rgyud drug bsgral ba'i phyag cha ni: 'dam skyes skyon bral rang gi rtags su bsnams: nyon mongs 'ching gcod ral gri tha mas rdeg: srid gsum sreg byed me thab dmar nag dang: dug chen klu 'dul dpa' bo khyung gi khra: brang 'gro zhal gsol za byed mche ba gtsigs: dur khrod du ma sku la brgyan byas nas: rta skad bsgrags pas bdud tshogs stong par byed: dbang chen gsung sprul klu 'dul khyod la bstod: klu bdud gdug pa 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dbang chen thugs las sprul pa'i khro bo bcu: 'jigs pa'i kha dog gdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan: drag po'i phyag gis mchod cha cir yang bsnams: 'dod pa'i re skong yum la thabs kyis 'khyud: sprul pa'i pho nya yang sprul bye bas bskor: 'jigs byed khro rgyal bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyogs skyong dregs pa 'dul ba'i las mdzod cig: bh+yo: dbang chen sku la 'khril pa'i yum chen mo: gzi ldan pad+ma khro bo kun gyi yum: e yi ngang nas srid gsum 'char byed ma: dbang gi sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: g.yas pas tri shul rtse gsum bdud dpung 'joms: g.yon pas dmar chen thod pa yab la stob: sbrul dang thal khrag rus pa du mas brgyan: dbu yi ral pas 'jig rten sman mo 'dul: srid gsum 'dul byed gser dang bai ḍūr+ya: dbu yi rgyan byas thams cad zil gyis gnon: yum chen gzi ldan pad+ma can la bstod: 'dod chags chen pos bdud dpung rdul du rlogs: bh+yo: sgrol yum chen mo sgeg mo ral gcig ma:

smug nag dug gyon khrag gi ral pa can: mdzes pa'i mche bas snang srid dbang sdud ma: gdug pa'i zhal gyis skye 'gro sgrol byed ma: g.yas pas spu gris sgrol ba'i las byed ma: g.yon pas tsit+ta 'bar ba gsol nas kyang: rus chen zhal du gsol ba'i zhe sdang can: sbrul nag gos gyon bdud mo bye ba'i bdag: sgrol yum chen mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: srid gsum sgrol ba'i ma mo chen mo khyod: zhe sdang drag pos skye 'gro dbang du sdus: bh+yo dza: yab yum gnyis med byang sems 'phro 'du las: log lta sgrol byed sprul pa'i phra men ma: thabs las mchog gyur dbu brnyan dur khrod bdag: rang bzhin gcig gyur khams gsum sgrol la mkhas: skye 'gro ma lus bkrag dang mdangs 'phrog cing: 'gugs pa'i lcags kyus don snying khong nas 'byin: 'ching ba'i zhags pas gdug pa'i yan lag sdom: 'debs pa'i phur bus rnam shes thang la ldog: zhing chen g.yang gzhi stong gsum dbang du sdud: res 'ga' sprul tsa ltas ngan wa spyang btang: 'jab pa'i stobs kyis log lta rdul du rlog: phra men las byed tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: dbang phyug chen mo kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod: sha chen khrag la rol zhing ma mo sdud: dbang chen pho nyar btang ba'i phra men ma: phrin las mdzad pa'i thugs dam g.yar dgongs shig: gdug pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus la bab: hūm̐ bh+yo: gzhan yang yang sprul gnas kyi ma mo brgyad: yul bdag phra men chen mo brgyad rnams dang: dbang gi mkha' 'gro sgo ma bse mo bzhi: dbang phyug mkha' 'gro nyi shu brgyad la sogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: dbang chen gsang ba dur khrod mchog gi bdag: bka' yi las byed phyogs skyong dam can tshogs: lha brgyad klu brgyad bar snang gza' chen brgyad: nor bdag rta brgyad sde dpon chen po bzhi: dbang chen sprul 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod:

thugs rje'i thabs kyis 'gro ba'i don dgongs shing: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las dus la bab: khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud pa dang: srid gsum zil gnon snang srid bran du khol: zil gnon rnam gnyis mchog gi dngos grub stsol:

de nas dzap bskul zhing bsnyen pa'i rim pa ni: hūm̐: dbang chen dmar nag me yi dkyil 'khor du: zla gam pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka: yum chen pad+ma gzi ldan sgrol yum bcas: sku gsung thugs sprul khro bo khro mo'i tshogs: byi la pu shud ma mo phra men dang: sprul pa yang sprul bka' yi 'khor tshogs bcas: sku ni rngam brjid gsung ni sngags sgra sgrog: thugs ni 'du 'phro sngags kyi 'od zer 'gyed: dbang chen lha tshogs thugs dam gnad nas bskul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: de nas dang po rig sngags ltar bzlas pa ni: oṃ pad+ma dha ra hrīḥswā hā: gnyis pa gsang sngags ltar bzlas pa ni: oṃ ha ya grī ba hūm̐: gsum pa bla med ltar bzlas pa ni: hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: bh+yo di ma da ri e ka tsā ti ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: bzhi pa gzungs sngags ltar bzlas pa ni: rta mchog yid bzhin nor bu'i gzungs ltar ro: de nas las sbyor khro 'dus ni: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: nā ga dz+wa la raṃ phaṭa raṃ he raṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la: gardza gardza kha kha khā hi khā hi: tshin+dha tshin+dha: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha: bhan+dha bhan+dha: ha na ha na: da ha da ha: s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa: pa tsa pa tsa: hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: yum la brten pa'i las sbyor: oṃ ha ya grī ba hūm̐: bh+yo di ma da ri e ka tsā ti ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: ma ma dun ting sa ma ya: ma ma ru lu baṃ nan: ru ru tsa pa la: trag rak+sha trag rak+ṣa baṃ yaṃ thuṃ ri li li ma mo nag mo kha 'dar sha ya: tsi baṃ: ru ti tsi pa thun bh+yo: rak+ta ku mun ta thun bh+yo: bhur bh+yo: sha la khaṃ: srog la rbad: ces gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags 'dus pa'i las sbyor te: mdor na bsnyen sgrub las gsum thams cad 'di rnams su ma 'dus pa med do:

gsang zhig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gtor 'bul sogs gzhung gong 'og khyad par rdzogs chen yi dam sgrub skor ltar bya: / /: gu h+ya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa tshogs bya ba ni: dang po gsag cing zhu ba: bskrad cing byin rlabs pa: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa: gsum pa tshogs mchod pa: bzhi pa tshogs 'bul ba la rim pa gsum: lnga pa lhag ma bya ba: drug pa bskul ba: bdun pa chad tho: brgyad pa brtan ma: dgu pa gtor bro: bcu pa dngos grub blang ba: bcu gcig pa bshags pa: bcu gnyis pa smon lam: bcu gsum pa bkra shis: bcu bzhi pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba: bco lnga pa rgyun khyer lam du bslang ba'o: rjes kyi rtsa tho rgyas pa rdzogs so: / /: de la dang po gsag pa ni: tshogs kyi yo byad 'bru sna shing thog gal phye chang sna mngar gsum gyis sbrus la: zla gam bzhi yi lte bar zur brgyad bya: de'i steng du tshogs lha chen tsit+ta ltar bya: de'i mtha' skor du zhal zas 'byor tshogs lde gu: su ra: sha tshod: dkar mngar: shing thog: tsā ru: chang tshogs tshad: sha bcas bshams nas slob bus zhu ba: ho: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs 'dus pa rgya mtsho rnams dgongs 'tshal: nged tsho bla med he ru ka dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du tshogs kyi 'khor lo bshams pa lags pas byin gyis brlab cing tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs pa'i phrin las gnang 'tshal: ces zhu: de nas bsang chu 'thor zhing: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ dang: oṃ sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ne hūm̐: ces lan gsum gyis sbyangs shing bsregs nas: sku gsung thugs 'bru gsum 'khor lo gsum gyis byin gyis brlab pa ni: thod rnga dril bu dang bcas la: oṃ: bde bar gshegs pa sku yi byin rlabs las: dkar po oṃ gyi 'od zer 'phro 'du yis: tshogs gzhong pad+ma bhan+dha'i dkyil 'khor du: zhe sdang las byung tshogs kyi zhal zas kun: dkar la mdangs chags ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: 'dzad med bdud rtsi'i 'od zer chen po la:

'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis brgyan pa 'di: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mnyes gyur nas: bdag cag 'dir 'tshogs rnal 'byor thams cad kyi: rgyud la gnas pa'i nyon mongs zhe sdang kun: thugs rje byams pa chen por gnas bsgyur nas: bdag gi lus 'di bde gshegs rgyal ba'i sku: mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par byin gyis rlobs: ā: bde bar bshegs pa gsung gi byin rlabs las: dmar po āḥyi 'od zer 'phro 'du yis: tshogs gzhong pad+ma bhan+dha'i dkyil 'khor du: 'dod chags las byung tshogs kyi zhal zas kun: dmar la mdangs chags ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: zag med bdud rtsi'i 'od zer chen po la: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis brgyan pa 'di: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mnyes gyur nas: bdag cag rnal 'byor 'dir 'tshogs thams cad kyi: rgyud la gnas pa'i nyon mongs 'dod chags kun: zag med bde ba chen por gnas bsgyur te: bdag gi ngag 'di bde gshegs rgyal ba'i gsung: gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cur byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: bde bar gshegs pa thugs kyi byin rlabs las: mthing ka hūm̐ gi 'od zer 'phro 'du yis: tshogs gzhong pad+ma bhan+dha'i dkyil 'khor du: gti mug las byung tshogs kyi zhal zas kun: mthing la mdangs chags ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: zag med bdud rtsi'i 'od zer chen po la: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis brgyan pa 'di: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mnyes gyur nas: bdag cag rnal 'byor 'dir 'tshogs thams cad kyi: rgyud la gnas pa'i nyon mongs gti mug kun: chos dbyings ye shes chen por gnas bsgyur nas: bdag gi sems 'di bde gshegs rgyal ba'i thugs: ye shes lnga dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ga ṇa tsakra gu ṇa pū dza āḥhūm̐: de nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni:

hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang nas: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: o rgyan rgyal po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rig 'dzin grub thob brgyud pa'i tshogs bcas rnams: rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang: ā ral+li dang hūm̐ gi sgra sgrog cing: rol mo sil snyan mang po si li li: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha khra la la: sna tshogs glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: 'dir gshegs zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: a la la ste dgyes par bzhes nas kyang: smin grol mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: zla gam dbang chen rol pa'i pho brang nas: pha rgyud g.yo ba rlung gi he ru ka: dbang chen rta mchog yab yum dbang gi lha: sku gsung thugs sprul khro bo khro mo dang: dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams: rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang: ā ral+li dang hūm̐ gi sgra sgrog cing: rol mo sil snyan mang po si li li: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha khra la la: sna tshogs glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: 'dir gshegs zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: a la la ste dgyes par bzhes nas kyang: smin grol mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: gsang chen rol pa chos 'byung dkyil 'khor nas: ma rgyud bde ba nyams kyi rnal 'byor ma: rdo rje phag mo sangs rgyas kun gyi yum: gsang ba ye shes sgrol yum ral gcig bcas: dpa' mo rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams: rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang: ā ral+li dang hūm̐ gi sgra sgrog cing: rol mo sil snyan mang po si li li: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha khra la la: sna tshogs glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: 'dir gshegs zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: a la la ste dgyes par bzhes nas kyang: smin grol mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: thar pa'i grong mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas:

ma mo phra men dbang phyug sgo ma dang: ye shes las la grub pa'i bka' 'khor tshogs: gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas: rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang: ā ral+li dang hūm̐ gi sgra sgrog cing: rol mo sil snyan mang po si li li: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha khra la la: sna tshogs glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: 'dir gshegs zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: a la la ste dgyes par bzhes nas kyang: smin grol mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: 'jig rten las kyis sprul pa'i dur khrod nas: myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs nus pa can: bka' yi pho nya phyogs skyong lha srin tshogs: zhing skyong 'jig rten mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas rnams: rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang: ā ral+li dang hūm̐ gi sgra sgrog cing: rol mo sil snyan mang po si li li: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha khra la la: sna tshogs glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: 'dir gshegs zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: a la la ste dgyes par bzhes nas kyang: smin grol mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: bka' dang dam tshig chen po'i pho brang nas: bstan pa srung zhing bar chad sel mdzad pa: ma mgon lcam dral nor lha dam can tshogs: chos skyong srung ma gter bdag ma lus rnams: rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang: ā ral+li dang hūm̐ gi sgra sgrog cing: rol mo sil snyan mang po si li li: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha khra la la: sna tshogs glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: 'dir gshegs zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: a la la ste dgyes par bzhes nas kyang: phyi nang bar chad ma lus bsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sarba bi shwa lo ka sa ma ya: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza a mṛta la khā hi: de nas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med par sprul nas tshogs kyis mchod pa ni:

gar rus rgyan dang bcas nas tshogs rdzas thogs te: oṃ āḥhūm̐: pad+ma bhan+dha mtshan ldan snod kyi mchog: chos dbyings nam mkha' mnyam pa'i snod nang du: rdo rje me rlung thod par sbyor ba yis: tshogs kyi zhal zas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho la: sku lnga ye shes lnga yi 'od zer las: 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga ru 'phros: longs spyod sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung gtibs: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la: gzugs kyi rdo rje mas kyang mchod pa'i phyir: gzugs mdzes me tog spyan gyi mchod pa rnams: rdo rje gzugs kyi lha mos thogs nas kyang: phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' khyab par mngon sprul te: rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i glu blangs shing: rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i gar bsgyur nas: rnal 'byor tshogs mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la: sgra yi rdo rje mas kyang mchod pa'i phyir: rol mo sil snyan snyan gyi mchod pa'i tshogs: rdo rje sgra yi lha mos thogs nas su: phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' khyab par mngon sprul te: rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i glu blangs shing: rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i gar bsgyur nas: rnal 'byor tshogs mchod 'di 'bul bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la: dri yi rdo rje mas kyang mchod pa'i phyir: dri mchog bdug spos shangs kyi mchod pa rnams: rdo rje dri yi lha mos thogs nas kyang: phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' khyab par mngon sprul te: rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i glu blangs shing: rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i gar bsgyur nas: rnal 'byor tshogs mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la: ro yi rdo rje mas kyang mchod pa'i phyir: ro mchog zhal zas ljags kyi mchod pa rnams: rdo rje ro yi lha mos thogs nas kyang:

phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' khyab par mngon sprul te: rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i glu blangs shing: rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i gar bsgyur nas: rnal 'byor tshogs mchod 'di 'bul bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la: reg bya rdo rje mas kyang mchod pa'i phyir: reg bya bde 'jam sku yi mchod pa rnams: rdo rje reg bya lha mos thogs nas kyang: phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' khyab par mngon sprul te: rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i glu blangs shing: rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i gar bsgyur nas: rnal 'byor tshogs mchod 'di 'bul bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la: chos kyi rdo rje mas kyang mchod pa'i phyir: bde stong gnyis med thugs kyi mchod pa rnams: rdo rje chos kyi lha mos thogs nas kyang: phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' khyab par mngon sprul nas: rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i glu blangs shing: rdo rje'i bar du gsang ba'i gar bsgyur nas: rnal 'byor tshogs mchod 'di 'bul bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra sarba pū dza ba liṃ ta su ra pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: dang po dkyil 'khor gyi lha la 'bul: gnyis pa 'khor la tshogs 'bul zhing bshags: gsum pa nya bo byas nas bsgral ba'o: dang po ni: hūm̐: bla med tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di: bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams la mchod par 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: 'dus pa'i mched lcam rnams kyis dgyes par rol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra ma hā su kha pū dza ho: bar pa bshags shing bskang ba ni: ho: yi dam dgongs 'dus lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa dang: nyes tshogs 'gal 'khrul gyur pa ci mchis pa: zhal zas longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags:

mthol bshags bzod pa dang du yar bzhes la: sku gsung thugs kyi thugs dam gnyan po bskang: lta ba shes rab gsal bas thugs dam bskang: sgom pa yengs 'khrul bral bas thugs dam bskang: spyod pa brtul zhugs klong du gyur pas bskang: 'bras bu bde gshegs dgongs rtogs thugs dam bskang: thugs dam bskang ngo tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: tha ma bsgral bstab ni: dang po dgug gzhug byas nas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: bdag ni dbang drag pad+ma he ru ka: phyag g.yas 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu phyogs bcur gdengs: g.yon pas bsgral ba'i phur bus dgra snying gzir: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod par byed pa'i bgegs: bar chad byed pa'i dam sri 'byung po rnams: rdul du rlogs la dbyings su da sgrol cig: ru dra dug lnga'i lnga phung rtsad nas chod: dgra bgegs dam sri sha trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: las sngags bcas kyis bsgral: de nas bstab pa ni: hūm̐: bzhengs shig pad+ma he ru ka: dbang drag zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du stims shig ā ral+li: chos kyi dbyings su bzhes su gsol: mnyam nyid rig pa'i ngang du sgrol: ma rig nyon mongs med par mdzod: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī dgra bgegs dam nyams rnams kyi ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti la khā hi:

zhes drag tu bstab bo: de nas lhag ma bya ba ni: oṃ badz+ra a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: gsum gyis sbyang: de nas: oṃ āḥhūm̐ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ye swā hā: gsum gyis bsngo: de nas phud lhag bsres nas chab bran te: sarba ḍā ki nī sa ma ya dza: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: sa ma ya ho: de nas lhag len gyis lhag ma 'gyog nas: hūm̐: dbang chen zhi khro'i tshogs kyi lhag sdud ni: phyi rol dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa yi: mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro zhing skyong phra men ma: lha chen kun gyi chung ma nyi shu brgyad: gdug pa'i tshogs 'joms mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis: zhing chen bsgral mdzad ging chen bco brgyad dang: dbang chen dregs pa'i ma mo bdun rnams dang: ti ra za bar byed pa'i sring mo bzhi: kham rgya dmus long pho nya sprul pa'i tshogs: ging dang laṅka dur khrod bdag mo dang: gnod byed snying nas 'dren pa'i 'bar ma brgyad: bka' yi srung ma mgon po bdun cu gnyis: phyi nang las byed pho nya drug cu bzhi: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro bye ba'i tshogs: ma mo phra men 'byung po sha za'i rigs: gshin rje srin po yi dwags sde brgyad tshogs: phyi 'khor srung ma bka' yi pho nya rnams: rang rang 'khor g.yog bran dang pho nya'i tshogs: phud la grub pa'i lhag ma 'dud rtsi'i tshogs: dam tshig srog dang 'brel ba'i zhal chab btab: mna' tshig dam bca' bzhag pa'i tha tshig bsgrags: srung ma pho nya tshur byon tshur la byon: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa: ji ltar bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: oṃ sarba ḍā ka ḍā ki nī lo ka uts+tshiṣ+ṭa badz+ra saṃ bu hur ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes phul: de nas bskul pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po'i zhing 'di ru: dmar nag zla gam gdan gyi bkod pa la: sha chen lang ling ji ltar spungs pa dang: rak+ta khrag chen mtsho ltar bskyil ba dang:

king rus gsar rnying rdza ltar lhags pa dang: bhan+dha mang po brung ltar brtsegs pa la: tsit+ta chen po rin chen sgong ltar 'gril: tshil chen gsur gyi dud pa ngad gsang 'khrigs: go ro tsa na'i sprin chen rab tu gtibs: dri chu dri chen rlung ltar 'phyo ba la: ba su rgyu zhags rgya gram dra ba ris: rtsa chen thig gdab rtsa phran rgya gram 'bar: sor tshigs lhu yi rtsig pa phyogs bcur 'gebs: nyi zla 'od 'bar phyogs bcur gsal bkod cing: sha chen sgron mes ma rig mun pa sel: de 'dra'i dur khrod 'bar ba'i gnas mchog 'dir: dbang chen rta mgrin dkyil 'khor ma lus pa: dgra bgegs 'byung po 'dul phyir spyan 'dren na: thugs rje chen pos dgongs la 'dir gshegs shig: bdud dpung dbang du sdud pa'i gar gyis la: srid gsum thal bar brlag pa'i skad phyungs shig: dbang mchog khro rgyal khyod kyi dus la bab: dgra bgegs ma lus 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: 'dod chags chen po ye nas dag pa'i sku: pad+ma gzi ldan yum gyi dkyil 'khor du: rngams chen he ru ka yi skur bzhengs nas: rig pa byang chub sems kyi chu bo yis: pad+ma dbang chen thugs dam bskul ba dang: lha tshogs rnams kyi nga rgyal skyed pa dang: rnal 'byor pho mo bsod nams gsog pa dang: lha klu gdug pa dbang du sdud pa'i phyir: zhe sdang chen pos bstan pa'i dgra sgrol cig: bh+yo: srid gsum sgrol ba'i sgeg mo ral gcig ma: e yi klong du 'khor 'das zlum mdzad pa'i: sgrol ba'i ma mo khyod kyi dus la bab: rnal 'byor bstan pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang: 'khor ba ka nas dag pa'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐: dbang chen sku sprul khro rgyal gtum drag gis: snang srid dbang du sdud pa'i las mdzod cig: gsung sprul khro bo klu 'dul chen po yis: klu bdud gdug pa 'dul ba'i dus la bab: thabs shes gnyis kyi sprul pa chen po yis: dgra bgegs dgug cing sdom pa'i las mdzod cig:

thugs sprul khro rgyal yab yum bcu rnams dang: ke ri siṃ ha dbang phyug phra men dang: bse mo bzhi dang phyogs skyong lha chen brgyad: klu brgyad gza' brgyad gnod sbyin nor bdag brgyad: rā hu re ti bdud nag klu bdud sogs: pho nya yang sprul dbang chen bka' sdod tshogs: thugs dam thugs bskyed chen po'i dus la bab: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las mthu ma chung: phyi nang bar chad zlog cing bstan dgra sod: gang la bya ba'i dmigs bya ma gtang sgrol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob par mdzod: hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta ru lu ru lu hūm̐ phaṭa: he he da ri hu lu hu lu hi hi: zhes bskul: de nas chad tho gyer ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe bskal pa'i thog ma dang po la: rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings pho brang du: thog ma'i ston pa kun tu bzang po yis: rang byung 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa yis: cir snang rang grol gtor ma blang ba dang: dug lnga'i dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: 'khor 'das dbyer med gtor ma 'di longs la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og dus tshigs bskal pa'i dbus ma la: dran pa yengs med ting 'dzin rgyal po yis: dran shes bag yod dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: 'gyu byed phra rags rang gzugs bstan pa yis: gnyen po rang grol gtor ma blang ba dang: rnam rtog rkun bu bsgral bar ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: cir snang rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i bar ma la: rgyu rkyen ma grub pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: mos pa'i blos bzung dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: sems nyid cho 'phrul rang gzugs bstan pa yis: snang srid ye grol gtor ma blang ba dang: rnam g.yeng dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dam:

sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: dran snang rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og dus kyi bskal pa'i tha ma la: tsa ri gsang sngags mkha' 'gro'i pho brang du: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: shes rab gsang yum mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gyis: ma hā gu ru'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du: yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa dang: bla ma mchog sgrub dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: mkha' 'gro dam can ma mgon zhing skyong gis: dgyes shing rang rang phyed gzugs bstan nas kyang: bka' yi gtor ma blang bar ma chad dam: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor skyong bar zhal bzhes pas: rig 'dzin bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ma ma yo gi nī i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi: de nas brtan skyong mchod pa ni: hūm̐: rtsa gsum rigs 'dus o rgyan bka' nyan pa'i: brtan ma skyong ma ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong rnams: sprul pa yang sprul rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab: 'dod dgur bsgyur bas cha lugs cir yang ston: zas su sha dang khrag la rngams zhing dgyes: las su sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srung: dam tshig can rnams srung zhing sdongs grogs mdzad: dpal chen bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig: bstan pa'i rgyud srungs sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzod: brtan ma bcu gnyis skyong ma khyed rnams kyis: sngon tshe pad+ma'i bka' bzhin mchod gtor longs: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: pra mo hā ma ma la lā le lai sring 'gro ma i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: de nas bro rgyas btab pa ni: hūm̐: bzhengs shig dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams: dpa' bo yab yum gnyis med sbyor: gnyis med sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las: bde ba chen po'i bro zhig brdung: gnod byed dgra bgegs ma lus non: bro ni ye shes chen po'i bro:

glu ni theg pa chen po'i glu: dgra ni thal bar brlag pa'i bro: bdud gshed phye mar 'thag pa'i bro: gzung 'dzin zhen pa rdul du brlag: oṃ laṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: āḥlaṃ: s+t+waṃ bha ya: nā sha ya: mā ra ya nan: de nas dngos grub blang ba ni: hrīḥho: rtsa gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: sgrub mchog skal ldan mched lcam thams cad la: bla ma rig 'dzin kun 'dus o rgyan gyis: byin rlabs mi zad gter gyi dngos grub stsol: yi dam kun 'dus rta mchog dbang gi lhas: mchog dang thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub stsol: mkha' 'gro kun 'dus gsang sngags theg pa'i bdag: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: chos skyong kun 'dus ma mgon dam can tshogs: mthu rtsal myur mgyogs thogs med dngos grub stsol: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ kā ya sid+dhi ā+oṃ: āḥbā ka sid+dhi ā: hūm̐ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: hrīḥsarba sid+dhi hrī: zhes dngos grub blang: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: e ma ho: dbang chen rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs: ma rig bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis: legs byas 'di la nyes shing 'gal gyur pa: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang: yan lag nyer lnga'i dam tshig nyams gyur pa: cho ga chad lhag ting 'dzin ma gsal zhing: sngags dang snying po mchod rdzas ma tshang nyams: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dang 'gal gyur kun: klong yangs chen po'i ngang du mthol lo bshags: rnam dag chos nyid ngang du dag gyur cig: ces he ru ka'i yig brgya: dbyangs gsal: rten 'brel snying po rnams tshar gang mang brjod: de nas bkra shis ni: hrī: chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i pho brang nas: rig 'dzin kun 'dus o rgyan thod phreng rtsal: thugs rjes byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chos char 'beb: thugs dgongs rnam dag mchog gyur bkra shis shog: dkyil 'khor rnam dag pho brang me dpung dbus:

yi dam kun 'dus gtso mchog rta mgrin tshogs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun gyi mdzod: sgrub pa rnam dag mchog gyur bkra shis shog: mkha' spyod gnas gsum rnam dag pho brang nas: mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso mo phag gdong ma: bsnyen sgrub las bzhi phrin las yongs kyi bdag: phrin las rnam bzhi myur 'grub bkra shis shog: dur khrod gsang chen gnas gsum pho brang nas: chos skyong dam can ma mgon pho nya'i tshogs: phrin las mthu stobs zhi drag las mdzad pa'i: sangs rgyas bstan srung mtha' rgyas bkra shis shog: theg chen gsang sngags zab mo'i pho brang nas: gsang sngags zab mos bdud rtsi'i yon tan rgyas: theg dgu'i 'brug sgra phyogs bcur khyab pa yi: bde gshegs dgongs pa 'dus pa'i bkra shis shog: skyo shas mos gus dam tshig pho brang nas: grogs mchog rdo rje spun gyi dad gus stobs: bskyed rdzogs zab mos 'bras bu'i ro myong bas: ting 'dzin nyams len gong 'phel bkra shis shog: de nas bsngo ba smon lam ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: mkha' khyab byang chub sems kyi gzhal yas su: srid par gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyis: dus gsum dus min bsags pa'i dge ba rnams: gzhon nu bum pa sku yi lhums su rdzogs: tshogs gnyis mthar phyin yongs grol chen por bsngo: smon lam ni: ho: bdag cag dkyil 'khor bsnyen sgrub mthus: sems can ji srid gnas kyi bar: bdag gis brtson pas don byed cing: thams cad 'khor ba las sgrol bas: bdag cag byang chub thob byed shog: 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i lam: snang ba bzhi po mthar phyin nas: 'pho ba chen po'i lus bzung ste: gzhan don mtha' yas spyod par shog: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: ho: 'gro 'dul yi dam dkyil 'khor lha: rang gsal rang rdzogs thig le zlum: dbus mtha' bral zhing nyag gcig gyur: skye med ngang du badz+ra mu: dmigs med rgyas gdab bo: stong pa'i ngang las slar yang rang nyid he ru ka dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa:

rgyan thams cad kyis sgeg pa'i dpa' bo gcig par gyur: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta ha ya grī ba hūm̐: zhes chad mtha' bsal phyir lam khyer bya'o: yul snang thams cad gzhal yas khang: gzugs snang thams cad yi dam lha: sgra grags thams cad sngags kyi sgra: dran rtog thams cad thugs kyi ngang: bcas bcos med pa'i ngang du bzhag: ces bya bas las rjes spyi ltar bya: spros pa la dga' ba rnams kyis las byang che ba ltar du shes so: spros pa che ba mi dga' ba rnams kyis gzhung 'di ltar spyod par byos shig: ces yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa'i las byang bsdus pa nor bu pad+ma'i phreng ba zhes bya ba mtsho rgyal ma dang nam mkha'i snying po gnyis kyi don la tsa ri tra zil chen rdo rje gsang ba'i phug tu o rgyan chen po pad+ma saṃ bha bas mdzad pa rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gnyan rgya: dam rgya: zab rgya: ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bdag stag sham pas gter nas spyan drangs shing*/ rang gi thugs dam byed rgyur bsams nas snying rus u tshug gis shog ser las phab pa yin/ gzhan las byang mang nyung shin tu mang po 'dug pas ci byed/ thugs dam ni byed mkhan med/ chos la sus rtsi/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram du chu la rtsis che ba ga la byed/ gzhan ni rang rang gi grub mthas bsgyur/ grwa pa rnams kyi kha stabs mo gsham gyi bu la re tshe skyo ba las ma mchis ang*/ ces 'brug lo zla ba drug pa'i bcu bdun nyin mo bris so// dge bar gyur cig/ //
